import itertools

def lattice(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    # sep candidates: colors forming complete separator lines
    best=None
    for v,n in cnt.most_common():
        sr=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==v for x in g[r])]
        sc=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==v for r in range(H))]
        if sr and sc and v!=9:
            return v,sr,sc
    # fallback: most common != 9
    for v,n in cnt.most_common():
        if v==9: continue
        sr=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==v for x in g[r])]
        sc=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==v for r in range(H))]
        if sr or sc: return v,sr,sc
    return None,None,None

    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])

    if v==fill: fill=None
    pt=[[g[r][c] if g[r][c]!=v else fill for c in sc] for r in sr]
    return v,pt

def build(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    # horizontal line rows: rows dominated by separator color
    cnt={}
    for r in inp:
        c=r.count(max(set(r), key=r.count))
        cnt[c]=max(cnt.get(c,0),c)
    # detect separator: most frequent overall
    sep=max(set(x for r in inp for x in r),key=lambda x:r.count(x) if False else sum(1 for r in inp for x in r if x==x)) 
    return None

def build(inp):
    C=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    sep=C.most_common(1)[0][0]

    hl=[r for r in range(H) if sum(x!=sep for x in inp[r])<=2]
    vl=[c for c in range(W) if sum(inp[r][c]!=sep for r in range(H))<=3]
    return sep,hl,vl
for name,inp in [('D1in',G['Demo pair 1 input']),('D2in',G['Demo pair 2 input'])]:

# Actually in D1: rows 1-2 etc have values 9 - that's the *fill*. The horizontal separator rows are rows 0,3,6,... where most cells are sep(1) but some cells hold colors 7,4,3 at column positions 0,4,8,12 — those columns are vertical separator columns!
# So: sep rows contain mostly sep except at sep-columns where the intersection shows a non-sep marker color. Output = grid of those intersection marker colors!
D1=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O1=G['Demo pair 1 output']
s=Counter(x for r in D1 for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
H,W=len(D1),len(D1[0])
hl=[r for r in range(H) if sum(x==s for x in D1[r])>=W-4]   # separator rows: mostly sep
vl=[c for c in range(W) if sum(D1[r][c]==s for r in range(H))>=H-5]
print(s,hl,vl)
tbl=[[D1[r][c] for c in vl] for r in hl]
for row in tbl: print(row)
print('expected',O1)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter
def f(inp):
    s=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r if x!=s)
    fill=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    # sep row: no fill cells
    seprows=[r for r in range(H) if all(inp[r][c]!=fill for c in range(W))]
    sepcols=[c for c in range(W) if all(inp[r][c]!=fill for r in range(H))]
    mr=[r for r in seprows if any(inp[r][c]!=s for c in sepcols)]
    mc=[c for c in sepcols if any(inp[r][c]!=s for r in mr)]
    def p(rows): return list(zip(rows[:-1],rows[1:]))
    pr=p(mr); pc=p(mc)
    out=[]
    for r1,r2 in pr:
        row=[]
        for c1,c2 in pc:
            vals={inp[r1][c1],inp[r1][c2],inp[r2][c1],inp[r2][c2]}
            row.append(next(iter(vals)) if len(vals)==1 else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    ok = f(G[name+' input'])==G[name+' output']
    print(name, ok)
    if not ok: print(' got',f(G[name+' input'])); print(' exp',G[name+' output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    # sep: color of the most uniform rows

    for c in cnt:

        if best is None or u>best[0]: best=(u,c)

    fill=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0] if len(cnt)>1 else next(iter(cnt))
    mr=[r for r in range(H) if sum(1 for x in inp[r] if x==sep)>=0.8*W]

    pr=list(zip(mr[:-1],mr[1:])); pc=list(zip(mc[:-1],mc[1:]))

            row.append(v.pop() if len(v)==1 else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    sep=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fill=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0] if len(cnt)>1 else None
    mark=set(cnt)-{sep,fill}
    # sep lines: rows/cols that are >=80% sep, preferring those containing a marker when tied
    def score(line):
        n=sum(1 for x in line if x==sep); return -n+(1e-9*n/len(line))  # more sep + penalize missing markers slightly
    best=[max(range(H), key=lambda r: sum(1 for x in inp[r] if x==sep)/W)]
    mrows=sorted([r for r in range(H) if sum(1 for x in inp[r] if x==sep)>=0.8*W])
    mcols=sorted([c for c in range(W) if sum(1 for r in range(H) if inp[r][c]==sep)>=0.8*H])
    out=[]
    for r1,r2 in zip(mrows,mrows[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c1,c2 in zip(mcols,mcols[1:]):
            cs=[inp[r1][c1],inp[r1][c2],inp[r2][c1],inp[r2][c2]]
            if cs[0]==cs[1]==cs[2]==cs[3] and cs[0]!=sep and cs[0]!=fill:
                row.append(cs[0])
            else:
                row.append(fill if fill is not None else 9)
        out.append(row)
    return out
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    got=f(G[name+' input']); exp=G[name+' output']
    print(name, got==exp)

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    sep=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fill=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0] if len(cnt)>1 else None
    mark=set(cnt)-{sep,fill}
    mrows=[r for r in range(H) if any(inp[r][c] in mark for c in range(W))]
    mcols=[c for c in range(W) if any(inp[r][c] in mark for r in range(H))]
    out=[]
    for r1,r2 in zip(mrows,mrows[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c1,c2 in zip(mcols,mcols[1:]):
            cs=[inp[r1][c1],inp[r1][c2],inp[r2][c1],inp[r2][c2]]
            u={x for x in cs if x!=sep and x!=fill}
            row.append(u.pop() if len(u)==1 else 9)
        out.append(row)
    return out
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    got=f(G[name+' input']); exp=G[name+' output']
    print(name, got==exp)
print(json.dumps(f(T)))

def analyze(inp):
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    sep=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]; fill=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]
    marks=(set(cnt)-{sep,fill})
    mrows=sorted({r for r in range(len(inp)) if any(inp[r][c] in marks for c in range(len(inp[0])))})

def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    sep=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fill=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0] if len(cnt)>1 else None
    mark=set(cnt)-{sep,fill}
    mrows=sorted({r for r in range(H) if any(inp[r][c] in mark for c in range(W))})
    mcols=sorted({c for c in range(W) if any(inp[r][c] in mark for r in range(H))})
    out=[]
    for r1,r2 in zip(mrows,mrows[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c1,c2 in zip(mcols,mcols[1:]):
            cs=[inp[r1][c1],inp[r1][c2],inp[r2][c1],inp[r2][c2]]
            s=Counter(cs).most_common()
            row.append(s[0][0] if s[0][1]==4 and s[0][0]!=sep and s[0][0]!=fill else (fill if fill is not None else 9))
        out.append(row)
    return out
